course.title: Construction and Project Management - II
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Prepare a mid-term audit report for a building construction project which have a (10) budgeted cost at TK. 1000000 with a total project duration 8 months. Also consider at the time of mid-term 40% construction work is completed at a cost of TK. 600000.
